payload.title: Owner-authorized shared publication inference across SaaS accounts
payload.description: As an engine owner, I want to explicitly permit another SaaS account to use narrowly scoped publication inference so that multiple publications can use one central Cyclotron without shared tenancy or private-data disclosure. Owner: cross-account-sharing. Central priming and PR58 are independent and must not wait for this feature. Two layers: shared central publication router, separately owned publication-internal section router. Definition of done: distinct identities, explicit grant/output/execution scope, revocation, audit, billing attribution, synthetic isolation tests and reviewed hosted integration. No live grant, credentials, DNS or production infrastructure is authorized.
